Name: DE-UserCosts
Statement:
select  usr.Oid as UserId,
        usr.Name as [User],
        umv.MonthlyValue,
        umv.HourlyValue,
        umv.StartDate,
        umv.EndDate,
        com.Oid as CompanyId,
        com.Name as Company,
        cur.Oid as CurrencyId,
        cur.Name as Currency,
        umv.CreatedOnUtc as CreatedOn,
        umv.ModifiedOnUtc as ModifiedOn
from    UserMonthlyValue umv, [User] usr, Company com, Currency cur
where   umv.[User] = usr.Oid and
        com.Oid = usr.Company and
        cur.Oid = com.Currency
